newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia samurai issue fully sold.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia samurai issue fully sold.

text.p: Tunisia's Central Bank on Wednesday said that a 15 billion yen 4.95 percent 15-year Samurai bond due September 27, 2011, was fully subscribed in less than a week.
"The issue on September 12 was fully subscribed by Japanese institutional investors. Usually, it takes a longer time particularly when we issue 15-year bonds," an official at the bank told Reuters.
The lead manager was Nikko Securities. The bonds were priced at par, with twice-yearly coupon payments.
